correctness.rationale: For disk-supported sigma(r,theta)=A(theta), the Fock reproducing kernel gives the positive Gaussian double-integral Hilbert-Schmidt quadratic form; angular Fourier rotation diagonalizes it into S_k(R). The monomial e_n shift coefficient is gamma(n+1+k/2,R^2)/sqrt(n!(n+k)!). Stochastic monotonicity bounds the shifted incomplete-gamma telescoping contribution by k, and 1-Gamma(n+1+k/2)^2/(Gamma(n+1)Gamma(n+k+1))~k^2/(4n). The weighted gamma cutoff sum is log(R^2)+O_k(1). Thus D_k/log R->k^2/2. Inequality 1-cos(k phi)<=k^2(1-cos phi) plus dominated convergence proves finite H1 energies and Fatou proves +infty otherwise, including unbounded L2 angular symbols via HS extension. Independent gamma evaluations for charges 1,2,5 at x=500,2000,8000 confirmed the slopes k^2/4 in log x.
residual_risks: Fixed charge O_k(1) is not uniform in k, but the separate exact D_k<=k^2D_1 domination supplies the required uniform summability. One complex dimension, Euclidean disk and Gaussian weight only.
